hint_ladder: Agree with your own claim only partly: say it holds from one angle, not from every angle.
Put the phrase at the front of the sentence, before the comma, and let the limited claim follow.
Start with the words: ___, the extra traffic taught us patience.
teaching_content.reveal_form: In a way, the extra traffic taught us patience.
canonical_forms: In a way, the extra traffic taught us patience.
alternative_realizations: In a way, I prefer the quieter office.
